seo.title: Wkil | WhatsApp order confirmation for cash-on-delivery brands
seo.description: Wkil sends a WhatsApp confirmation for every new order from your store and replies to customers on WhatsApp, Messenger and web chat. Direct EasyOrders connection.
seo.openGraphTitle: Wkil | Get customers to confirm on WhatsApp before you ship
seo.openGraphDescription: A WhatsApp confirmation for every new order, with Confirm and Cancel buttons, and an agent that answers customers from what you taught it about your business.

hero.title: Get customers to confirm on WhatsApp before you ship.
hero.subtitle: Wkil sends a confirmation message for every new order from your store, with a Confirm and a Cancel button, and the order status updates as soon as the customer answers. If the customer has a question, the agent answers from what you taught it about your business.
hero.note: For cash-on-delivery brands handling 30 to 100 orders a day, and agencies running stores for their clients.

orderDemo.ariaLabel: Example of a WhatsApp order confirmation
orderDemo.message: Hi Sara, we received order 1042: a mug set, EGP 450, cash on delivery. Shall we confirm it?
orderDemo.confirmedReply: Your order is confirmed. We will let you know when it ships.
orderDemo.canceledReply: Your order is canceled. If you change your mind, message us here.
orderDemo.hint: Tap a button in the message, the way a customer would.

how.title: An order canceled before shipping costs less than one that comes back.

steps.title: Connect your store and WhatsApp number
steps.text: EasyOrders connects directly. If your store is on another platform that can send orders to a webhook, you can connect that too.

steps.title: The customer gets the confirmation message
steps.text: Every new order reaches its customer on WhatsApp from your number, using a Meta-approved template with a Confirm and a Cancel button.

steps.title: See who confirmed and who canceled
steps.text: The orders page shows the status of each order, so you know what to ship and what to hold before handing over to the courier.

storeNote.title: Is your store on Zammit?
storeNote.text: There is no direct connection yet. If your store can send orders to a webhook you can connect it today. If you are not sure, write to support@wkil.app.

agent.title: After the confirmation, the agent keeps going
agent.subtitle: The agent replies with AI, using what you tell it about your business: your services, common questions, policies and the tone you prefer.

items.title: Replies to your customers
items.text: On WhatsApp, Messenger and web chat. When someone comments on your Facebook page, it sends them the details in Messenger.

items.title: Hands off to your team when needed
items.text: When a conversation needs a person, the agent pauses and your team gets a mobile notification.

items.title: Follows up with customers who went quiet
items.text: Automatic follow-ups, without anyone on your team having to remember them.

items.title: Remembers every customer
items.text: Customer memory keeps the important details from each conversation, so anyone on your team can pick up where it stopped.

items.title: Looks after your number
items.text: You set the daily limit for new customers, and extra messages wait and go out when the limit resets. If Meta lowers your number's quality, sending stops to reduce the risk of a restriction.

items.title: Prepares your posts
items.text: A content plan and written posts that you approve, then publish or schedule on your Facebook page.

chat.title: Ask the agent and see how it replies
chat.subtitle: This demo answers questions about Wkil itself. On your account, the agent answers from what you taught it about your business.
chat.initialMessage: Hi. Ask me about order confirmation, plans, or the channels we reply on.
prompts: I get 50 orders a day. Which plan fits?
chat.errorText: Could not send your message. Try again.
chat.ctaText: Want the agent answering your customers?

pricing.title: Clear pricing in EGP. Meta fees go straight to Meta.
pricing.subtitle: A conversation is one customer within 24 hours, however many messages they send. Up to 65 orders a day? Growth fits. More than that? Scale.
pricing.billingNote: Prices in Egyptian pounds per month. Pay yearly, get two months free, and your price stays fixed for 12 months.

plans.name: Free
plans.tagline: Try Wkil on your website and Messenger
features: Knowledge base for your business (website, services, FAQs)
"Powered by Wkil" badge on the chat

plans.name: Starter
plans.tagline: For the founder who still replies alone
features: 300 WhatsApp order confirmations per month (up to 10 orders a day) with Confirm and Cancel buttons
Automatic follow-ups for customers who went quiet

plans.name: Growth
plans.tagline: For the brand that gets orders every day
features: All channels: WhatsApp + Messenger + web chat
2,000 WhatsApp order confirmations per month (up to 65 orders a day)
Automatic follow-ups + lead capture and memory for every customer
5 users and handoff to your team with a mobile notification
CRM and external systems: the agent runs actions during the chat

plans.name: Scale
plans.tagline: For several brands or a full team
features: Up to 3 WhatsApp numbers and 3 businesses in one account (two without Meta verification; we set up verification for the third with you)
5,000 WhatsApp order confirmations per month (numbers above 100 confirmations a day need Meta business verification, which we set up with you)
Custom setup with the Wkil team

overage.title: Outgrew your plan this month?
overage.text: We tell you before you reach your plan's limit. After that, extra conversations cost EGP 1 each and extra order confirmations EGP 0.50 each. If your volume keeps growing, cheaper usage packs are available on Growth and Scale: talk to us.

addon.title: Need a second WhatsApp number for a second brand?
addon.text: Add an extra number for EGP 299 a month on Growth or Scale without changing your plan. Each number also gets 1,000 free reply messages a month from Meta.

meta.title: WhatsApp fees go straight to Meta
meta.text: Meta bills your own account directly, with no markup from Wkil: about EGP 0.25 per confirmation message, and about EGP 0.25 per WhatsApp reply after the first 1,000 messages each month. Messenger and web chat carry no Meta fees.

agency.title: Agency, company, or more than 3 numbers?
agency.text: More than 3 WhatsApp numbers, more than 5,000 orders a month, or an agency managing several clients? Custom plans start at EGP 7,999 a month, invoiced by bank transfer.
agency.cta: Sign up and message us inside Wkil

pricing.trialNote: Try the full Growth plan free for 14 days, no card needed, with real confirmations to your customers. Then pick a plan or stay on Free. Cancel any time from your account.

signup.title: Start free, and upgrade when you need order confirmation
signup.subtitle: The Free plan includes web chat and Messenger. WhatsApp order confirmation starts on the Starter plan.
